name: LRU Cache with Eviction
description: Implement a Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache in `app.py`. The `LRUCache(capacity)` must provide `get(key)` in O(1) time returning `None` if absent, and `put(key, value)` in O(1) time. When capacity is exceeded, evict the least recently used key. Updating an existing key or accessing a key via `get` marks it as most recently used. Raising `ValueError` if `capacity <= 0` is required.
visible_hint: Accessing an item refreshes its recency so it is not evicted first.
